'''2015 European Championship Day 2 Ziemowit Skwara LS Quiet Mining Colony''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Ziemowit Skwara]] at [[2015 European Championship]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Ziemowit Skwara]]
* '''Event:''' [[2015 European Championship]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]

* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open QMC Skwara LS 2015 EC.txt |Download]]

* '''Stage:''' Day 2
